old_caption: The video captures a heartwarming scene at a playground where an adult is pushing a child on a swing. The adult, dressed in a plaid shirt and jeans, stands behind the swing, holding onto the chains with both hands to gently propel the child back and forth. The child, wearing a light-colored sweater and blue pants, sits comfortably in the swing, laughing joyfully with their head tilted back. The background features a mix of greenery with trees displaying autumn foliage, suggesting the season. The sky appears overcast, adding a soft, diffused light to the scene. The playground equipment, including the swing set, is visible but slightly blurred, emphasizing the interaction between the adult and the child. The overall atmosphere is one of happiness and carefree play, highlighting the bond between the two individuals.

caption: The video captures an outdoor playground scene from a low, front-facing angle. A man in a dark plaid shirt and jeans stands behind a blue bucket-style swing seat, gripping its two metal chains in each raised hand. A young child in a cream distressed sweater, blue jeans and a pendant necklace sits in the seat, head tilted back, gazing upward. Throughout the excerpt the man's grip and the child's body drift downward within the frame, the seat sliding toward the bottom edge as the child's legs leave the shot. The man's torso leans progressively forward over the child, his gaze following her face. The child's expression opens from a neutral upward look into a wide smile, while the chains, her seated posture and the pendant persist unchanged. The autumn trees, pale building and the empty swing's pole at right remain fixed, marking the motion as belonging to the swing, not the camera.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness

prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
